biotools.summary: methylGrapher is a tool for genome-graph-based processing of DNA methylation data from whole genome bisulfite sequencing. It accurately analyzes WGBS data by mapping it to a genome graph, enabling the reconstruction of methylation patterns along haplotype paths.
